question: Which of the following is the largest bituminous coalfield in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharia**__.

__
 
• **Jharia **is the **largest bituminous coalfield in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Jharia **represents the **largest coal reserves **in India having estimated reserves of **19.4 billion tonnes** of coking coal.
 
• The coalfield lies in the **Damodar River Valley** and covers about **280 square km**.
